layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recently, camera-controlled video generation has seen rapid development,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: offering more precise control over video generation. However, existing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods predominantly focus on camera control in perspective projection

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video generation, while geometrically consistent panoramic video genera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion remains challenging. This limitation is primarily due to the inherent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: complexities in panoramic pose representation and spherical projection. To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: address this issue, we propose CamPVG, the first diffusion-based frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work for panoramic video generation guided by precise camera poses. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieve camera position encoding for panoramic images and cross-view

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature aggregation based on spherical projection. Specifically, we propose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a panoramic Plücker embedding that encodes camera extrinsic parameters

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through spherical coordinate transformation. This pose encoder effectively

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: captures panoramic geometry, overcoming the limitations of traditional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods when applied to equirectangular projections. Additionally, we in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: troduce a spherical epipolar module that enforces geometric constraints

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through adaptive attention masking along epipolar lines. This module en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ables fine-grained cross-view feature aggregation, substantially enhancing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the quality and consistency of generated panoramic videos. Extensive ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: periments demonstrate that our method generates high-quality panoramic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos consistent with camera trajectories, far surpassing existing methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in panoramic video generation.

layout_dets.text: 1 Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The rapid advancement of virtual reality (VR), metaverse technolo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gies, and embodied artificial intelligence has catalyzed a surge of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: interest in panoramic visual content. Panoramic videos, which cap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture a comprehensive 360-degree view of the surrounding environ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment, offer users an immersive experience. As the applications of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic videos expand, the demand for enhanced immersive ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: periences has continually increased. The development of scalable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic video generation with precise camera pose control has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: emerged as a critical area of research. This capability opens new

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frontiers for expansive applications in entertainment, interaction,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and beyond.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Generating panoramic videos with consistent camera motion and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal smoothness poses distinctive challenges. Many existing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: works on panoramic video generation, such as 360DVD [Wang et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2024a], Imagine 360 [Tan et al. 2024], and 4K4DGen [Li et al. 2024],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: primarily focus on generating dynamic content in panoramic videos

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: but offer limited control over camera perspectives. Consequently,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the generated panoramic videos exhibit minimal variation in view-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: points. To achieve precise camera pose control, recent approaches

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have made notable strides. For instance, MotionCtrl [Wang et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2024b] concatenates camera poses with features in the latent space,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while CameraCtrl [He et al. 2024] injects camera poses into the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: latent space using Plücker embedding. In addition, CamCo [Xu et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2024] and CamI2V [Zheng et al. 2024] further enhance scene consis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tency across different camera viewpoints by introducing geometric

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constraints through epipolar attention. However, these methods are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specifically designed for perspective projection video generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and show limitations when applied to panoramic domain. These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limitations stem primarily from the challenging representation of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic camera poses and the intrinsic geometric complexity of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic imagery.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To address these challenges, we propose CamPVG, the first diffusion·

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based framework for panoramic video generation guided by precise

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: camera poses. Our approach enables the generation of high-quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic videos that maintain consistency with given camera

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trajectories as shown in Fig. 1. Unlike prior perspective-based geo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: metric methods, our approach is not simply an adaptation of per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spective models to panoramic coordinate systems. Existing camera

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pose encoding methods are typically designed for perspective pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: jection camera trajectories and perform poorly on equirectangular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic data due to the inherent differences in imaging logic be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tween panoramic and perspective views. To achieve effective camera

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: position encoding for panoramic data, we introduce panoramic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Plücker embedding, building upon the foundation of traditional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Plücker embedding [He et al. 2024]. Our method models the spa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tial relationship between each pixel in the panoramic image and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the camera origin through spherical projection, representing this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: relationship using Plücker coordinates [Sitzmann et al. 2021]. These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spherically projected Plücker coordinates are then injected into the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: latent space via a pose encoder, providing spatial geometric guidance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: throughout the panoramic video generation process. Furthermore,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to enhance consistency across different camera viewpoints, we pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pose a spherical epipolar module for fine-grained feature aggre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gation. By leveraging the intrinsic properties of equirectangular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: projection, we calculate the spherical epipolar lines corresponding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to each pixel across different viewpoints. We then employ spherical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: epipolar masking with carefully designed sampling strategy along

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the epipolar line to filter out irrelevant pixel information. During

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the panoramic video generation process, we aggregate valid refer-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ence information from different viewpoints using spherical epipolar

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention, thereby achieving multi-view consistent panoramic video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CamPVG achieves supe-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rior performance in camera trajectory consistency, frame realism,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and overall video quality. Our method significantly surpasses exist-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing camera-controlled video generation approaches in panoramic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video generation. We believe that CamPVG will make substantial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contributions to the field of camera pose-guided panoramic video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation and its downstream applications. Our contributions can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be summarized as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We propose CamPVG, the first framework for panoramic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video generation guided by precise camera poses, enabling the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation of high-quality panoramic videos with consistent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: camera trajectories.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We introduce panoramic Plücker embedding, a novel ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proach for camera position encoding based on panoramic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We present the spherical epipolar module that leverages spher-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ical epipolar constraints to achieve fine-grained feature aggre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gation, enhancing multi-view consistency and visual fidelity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of panoramic videos.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2 Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1 Diffusion-Based Video Generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recent advancements in diffusion models [Gao et al. 2025a, 2024,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2025b; Jiang et al. 2024b,a; Tang et al. 2025] have significantly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: advanced research in video generation. Building on the success

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion frameworks such as Stable Diffu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion [Rombach et al. 2022], researchers have extended these models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to text-to-video (T2V) generation by incorporating temporal lay-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ers to process video input while retaining strong visual priors. For

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: instance, Video Diffusion Model [Ho et al. 2022], LVDM [He et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2022], and VideoCrafter [Chen et al. 2023, 2024] extend the 2D U-Net

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architecture of image diffusion models with spatial and temporal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: blocks, enabling coherent video generation through iterative denois-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing. Furthermore, Sora [Brooks et al. 2024] and CogVideoX [Yang

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. 2024] explore Transfomer-based diffusion framework inte-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grated with 3D-VAE, significantly enhanced the video generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: capabilities in terms of temporal consistency and visual fidelity. Ad-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ditionally, other works [Blattmann et al. 2023; Xing et al. 2024] have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: advanced image-to-video (I2V) generation by conditioning diffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models on image inputs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.2 Panoramic Video Generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The field of panoramic content generation has seen notable progress

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the advent of diffusion models, though most efforts remain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: focused on static panorama synthesis [Koh et al. 2021; Tang et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2023; Ye et al. 2024; Yuan et al. 2025; Zhang et al. 2024] rather than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video generation. Recent studies [Liu et al. 2025; Xie et al. 2025]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have increasingly explored diffusion-based frameworks to over-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: come these limitations. For instance, 360DVD [Wang et al. 2024a]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduces a lightweight 360-Adapter to fine-tune pre-trained T2I

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diffusion models, enabling panoramic video synthesis conditioned

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on textual prompts and motion signals. Imagine360 [Tan et al. 2024]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposes a dual-branch architecture that enforces joint local and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: global constraints, facilitating perspective-to-panoramic video con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: version. Another approach, 4K4DGen [Li et al. 2024], leverages 2D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: priors from perspective image generation models to denoise spher-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ical latent codes, yet the generated videos suffer from restricted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: viewpoint diversity due to inadequate motion modeling in the la-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tent space. While these methods demonstrate promising progress,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: their controllability over camera trajectories remains limited. Our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CamPVG advances the field by integrating explicit camera pose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: conditioning into the diffusion framework, enabling precise control

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: over viewpoint transitions in panoramic video generation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.3 Camera-Controlled Video Generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Camera-controlled video generation has emerged as a critical re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: search direction in diffusion-based video generation, aiming to pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: duce dynamic visual content aligned with predefined camera tra-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: jectories. Some approaches [Hu et al. 2024; Jain et al. 2024] achieve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coarse camera motion control through training-free methods. To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enable precise camera control, recent works integrate camera pose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information into diffusion frameworks. MotionCtrl [Wang et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2024b] concatenates noisy latent features with camera pose in tem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poral blocks, allowing camera-conditioned generation. Similarly,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CameraCtrl [He et al. 2024] encodes Plücker embeddings [Sitzmann

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. 2021] and injects them into the U-Net architecture. While

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these methods demonstrate improved controllability, their ability to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model 3D spatial relationships still limits. Addressing this limitation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: some methods [Kuang et al. 2024; Xu et al. 2024; Zheng et al. 2024]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduce epipolar attention mechanisms to explicitly model 3D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: geometric constraints. While effective for perspective-view gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ation, their effectiveness remains constrained in panoramic video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation. Our work extends this principle to panoramic domains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by reformulating epipolar attention for equirectangular projections.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3 Method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this section, we introduce our novel method for panoramic video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation guided by precise camera poses with spherical epipolar

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constraints, as illustrated in Fig. 2. We begin with the preliminary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: concepts of controllable video diffusion models and the represen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation of camera poses in Sec. 3.1. To encode camera trajectories

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for panoramas, we propose a panoramic Plücker embedding in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Sec. 3.2. To better capture geometric constraints between multi-view

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic frames, Sec. 3.3 details the proposed spherical epipolar

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1 Preliminary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1.1 Controllable Video Diffusion Model. Modern diffusion-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video generation frameworks synthesize content guided by multi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modal conditional inputs. These models enable user-specified video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: synthesis by conditioning the generation process on diverse signals,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: including textual prompts, reference image, and motion informa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. The framework operates in a compressed latent space derived

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through a learned auto-encoder architecture. Given an input video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sequence x

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: comprising N frames of resolution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the encoder & produces latent representations

layout_dets.text: 4.1.1 Dataset. To obtain panoramic video datasets incorporating

layout_dets.text: for each camera trajectory, and randomly sample 16 frames at a

layout_dets.text: 16 for 300 epochs, taking approximately 4 days to complete. For fair

layout_dets.text: comparison, we retrain baseline methods on our panoramic dataset

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the same training settings.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.1.3 Evaluation Metrics. As conventional pose estimation meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods [Pan et al. 2024; Schönberger and Frahm 2016] for perspective

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos are inapplicable to panoramic content, we assess camera

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trajectory consistency by comparing the fifth generated frame af-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ter conditioning inputs with corresponding ground truth frame.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This temporal offset allows us to avoid minimal differences in adja-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cent frames and excessive generative divergence in distant frames.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Frame-wise similarity is evaluated through Peak Signal-to-Noise

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) [Wang et al. 2004],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) [Zhang et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2018]. To evaluate the visual fidelity of generated panoramic frames,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we compute the Fréchet Auto-Encoder Distance (FAED) [Zhang

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. 2024] on selected fifth-frame instances. FAED extends the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [Heusel et al. 2017], and is specif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ically designed to address equirectangular projection distortions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Additionally, we evaluate the overall quality of the panoramic video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) [Skorokhodov et al. 2022; Un-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: terthiner et al. 2018; Yan et al. 2021] and VBench [Huang et al. 2024].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: All metrics are computed over 1,000 randomly sampled video clips.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.2 Comparisons with Baseline Methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.2.1 Quantitative Comparisons. As we propose the first frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work for precise camera pose-guided panoramic video generation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: existing methods are not directly comparable. Consequently, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapt and retrain three perspective-domain approaches, including

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CameraCtrl [He et al. 2024], MotionCtrl [Wang et al. 2024b], and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CamI2V [Zheng et al. 2024]. For fair comparison, we modify Mo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tionCtrl by retaining only its camera control module while disabling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: object motion components. All methods utilize DynamiCrafter as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the base model and are trained on our panoramic video datasets

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with precise camera pose annotations. As demonstrated in Tab. 1,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CamPVG achieves superior performance in camera view consis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tency metrics (PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS), indicating more accurate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reconstruction of panoramic views with less distortion and higher

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structural consistency.. Furthermore, our method preserves high

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video generation quality and visual fidelity, achieving the lowest

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: FVD and FAED scores and the highest VBench scores, owing to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: incorporation of geometric constraints. These results demonstrate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that our geometric-aware constraints bridge panoramic consistency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and generation fidelity.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: son between our method and existing baseline approaches in Fig. 5.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: catenating camera poses directly with latent space features. While

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross-view inconsistency and generates hallucinated content due to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the absence of panoramic geometric priors. In contrast, our method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: explicitly models panoramic camera poses and enforces spherical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: epipolar constraints, ensuring high-fidelity geometric consistency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across dynamically changing viewpoints. The panoramic videos

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generated by our approach effectively mitigate distortions while

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: preserving intricate scene details. Even in complex scenarios with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-room transitions, our approach maintains strict alignment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the input camera trajectory without introducing unrealistic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: artifacts. More generated results are shown in Fig. 7.

layout_dets.text: 4.3 Ablation Study

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.3.1 Ablation Study on Different Components. Our method inte-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grates geometric constraints through the panoramic Plücker embed-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ding and the spherical epipolar module. Additionally, we employ

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a random conditional frame strategy during training to enhance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the model's robustness. To validate the contribution of each com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ponent within CamPVG, we conduct ablation studies focusing on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these three critical components. Qualitative (Fig. 6) and quantita-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive results (Tab. 2) are presented. The results show that removing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the panoramic Plücker embedding leads to a larger performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: drop than removing the spherical epipolar module. The panoramic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Plücker embedding enables the model to comprehend panoramic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: camera pose information; without it, the model loses the ability to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: represent the panoramic space, leading to substantial performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: degradation. In contrast, the spherical epipolar module reinforces

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: geometric constraints across different viewpoints, thereby enhanc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing fine-grained consistency between generated frames. These find-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ings indicate that the panoramic Plücker embedding is fundamental

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for establishing global camera pose awareness, while the spherical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: epipolar module complements it by ensuring cross-view geomet-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ric consistency. Additionally, to assess the impact of the random

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: conditional frame strategy, we evaluate models trained without it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by adopting a different conditional frame order during testing. As

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shown in the results, models trained with a fixed frame order suffer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a significant performance drop across all evaluation metrics. This

layout_dets.text: 4.3.2 Ablation Study on Sampling Density. As discussed in Sec. 3.3.2,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: emphasize the necessity of carefully selecting an appropriate K to

layout_dets.text: 4.4 User Study

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To complement our quantitative comparison, we conduct a human

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: evaluation to compare our CamPVG against baseline methods (Mo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tionCtrl, CameraCtrl, and CamI2V). For each method, we generate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 20 panoramic video sequences using identical conditional frames.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across three dimensions: camera trajectory consistency, consistency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the conditional images, and overall video quality. Participants

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rate each aspect on a scale from 1 to 4, with higher scores indicating

layout_dets.text: better performance. To further evaluate the generalization capability

layout_dets.text: of our method, we additionally select real-world panoramic images

layout_dets.text: as conditional inputs and conduct an extended user study. As shown

layout_dets.text: in Tab. 4, CamPVG achieves superior ratings across all evaluation

layout_dets.text: dimensions, consistently outperforming the baseline methods. No-

layout_dets.text: tably, even under real-world inputs, our method attains the highest

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance (see the rightmost two columns of the table). These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: results highlight the effectiveness of CamPVG. Additional qualita-

layout_dets.text: 5 Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this work, we propose CamPVG, the first diffusion-based frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work for panoramic video generation guided by precise camera

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poses. By introducing panoramic Plücker embedding with the pose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder, our method effectively learns panoramic camera geome-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: try, enabling more accurate modeling of camera trajectories based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on panoramic images. Additionally, through the spherical epipolar

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module, we achieve fine-grained feature aggregation by leverag-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing features along epipolar lines from different viewpoints, thereby

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enhancing consistency across video frames. Compared to other

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: camera-controlled video generation methods, our approach demon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strate state-of-the-art performance in panoramic video generation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: excelling in camera trajectory consistency, frame realism, and over-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: all video quality.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Limitation. Our method is currently limited by the availability of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: panoramic datasets with accurate camera pose annotations, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: affects its performance in complex outdoor environments. Due to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these dataset constraints, the generated panoramic videos are pri-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: marily from static scenes.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Future Work. In future work, we plan to incorporate dynamic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scene panoramic data to enhance motion realism and improve the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generalization ability of our framework.
